comment_text: You stated best PERIMETER player. Back then, the best perimeter player wasn't the best player on the team. In fact, they weren't as big a deal as they are now. Maybe the fact that he was the best offensive player that also played pretty good defense hyped it up a little bit, but nonetheless, he definitely was one of the best.
